additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375167-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117098] DC2 Errorcode:7 CRM:01251000894
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre,
The
DC Error Code 7 correspond to the Power Converter Grouping
.
On this charger at the moment there is an active charging session on outlet 1, however the outlet 2 is having contactor Error :
CMD: 0, FBK: 0, WLE: 1, WDA: 1, WLD: 1, WIR: 0, WCD: 0
WLD : 1 , mean there is a contactor welding detected on QA13-14.
I Will wait for charging session to finish and then reboot the charger to see if it was a temporary error or there is a real issue with Contactors.
Will get back to you soon.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma

additional_info.body:
Hi Reetesh,
There is no any charging session. This is another bug.
Charging session appears...
The cable is not plugged in and it appears to be charging

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375167-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117098] DC2 Errorcode:7 CRM:01251000894
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre,
We rebooted the charger, and it fixed the issue. The problem may be because of a new algorithm implemented to check the welding detection of the contactor.
We have forwarded this issue to R&D with necessary information, for now the only available solution is to reboot the charger.
If reboot doesn't fix the issue, please create a new ticket.
I am proceeding with the case closure for now.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
